cs.t: In my haste I forgot to ask what kind of music you listen to. The soundmagic e10 is bass-heavy and you'll probably have to switch off your eq settings. I use them with my iPod classic (with flat eq setting) and they sound superb. However I found out that there's a bit of interference when I plug them into my MacBook Pro. I also sometimes use my AKG 451 which aren't as bass heavy as the e10 but also sound really good when listening to Amos Lee for instance. Bottom line is you should probably take your music player with you and have a listen before purchasing if possible or you'll just have to rely on review sites like WhatHifi.
